comment: Left ear cup audio cut out after 3 days. Active noise cancellation has a loud static buzz.
Headband plastic joint snapped while expanding. Left ear cup loses sound completely when tilted.
Bluetooth drops connection every 5 minutes when paired with laptop. Left side audio crackles.
Left speaker died completely after second charge. Battery drains in less than 2 hours.
Volume control buttons stuck and unresponsive. Audio balances only on the right ear cup.
Shoe size 9 feels like size 8. Very narrow toe box caused severe blisters on first run.
Sizing runs extremely small by at least 1 full size. Could not fit foot in comfortably.
Ordered size 10 but received box marked size 10 containing size 8.5 shoes. Toe box too tight.
Heel arch support collapses immediately. Shoe length is much shorter than standard sizing chart.
Scroll wheel rubber coating loose and slips without scrolling web pages. Cursor stutters.
Optical laser sensor stopped tracking movement on wooden mousepad after 48 hours.
Left mouse click double clicks randomly on single press. Scroll wheel click fails completely.
Cap rubber gasket seal missing out of the box. Bottle leaks water when stored horizontally.
Gasket seal inside lid loose. Water drips continuously from threading when drinking.
Vacuum insulation failed - exterior of bottle gets burning hot when filled with hot tea.
Blade edge arrived with visible chips right out of the box. Handle wooden rivet wobbles.
Tip of the knife blade was bent inside protective sheath upon delivery. Stainless steel rusted.
Full tang handle rivets came loose during vegetables prep. Metal blade metal feels soft.
Battery life drains from 100% to 0% in under 3 hours with heartbeat monitor enabled.
Screen touchscreen glass unglued from watch bezel casing. Touch controls unresponsive.
Step counter miscounts steps by 300%. Bluetooth disconnects from iOS phone constantly.
Hydraulic gas lift cylinder leaks pressure and sinks down automatically after 20 minutes sitting.
Lumbar support plastic bracket arrived cracked. Chair height adjustment lever jammed.
Mesh back fabric torn along side frame seam upon unboxing. Screws missing from armrest assembly.
Color faded from deep black to dull grey after first cold water wash cycle.
Shirt shrunk by two full sizes in width after gentle low-temp tumble drying.
Fabric material noticeably thinner than product photos. Seams unspooled along bottom hem.
HDMI 4K output flickering constantly on external display monitor. Hub body gets extremely hot.
Pass-through USB-C charging port disconnected external SSD drive causing data transfer loss.
Nonstick ceramic coating began flaking off into food on second low-heat cooking attempt.
Aluminum base warped on glass cooktop causing pan to wobble unevenly. Paint chipped on handle.
